_comment: Stage 4b settings (an additional modelling experiment: neural networks). Fixed BEFORE any network is trained or any result is read. Changing a value means a new evaluated experiment; never change them after looking at validation or test results.

periods._early_stopping_note: The early-stopping set is the eligible TRAINING rows dated 2026-03-10..2026-03-31. Networks, the route encoder and all scalers are fitted on eligible training rows before 2026-03-10 only. Validation (2026-04-01..2026-05-31) is never used in training or stopping: it is used only for selection, exactly as for the Random Forest. The networks therefore train on fewer rows than the Stage 4a models.
periods.test_status: reused holdout: June-July 2026 was examined while the method was developed (notebook); not an untouched final test

sequence.window: exact calendar dates D-28 .. D-1 for the same route
sequence._missing_note: A day with no record gets value 0 in SCALED units (= the training-mean boardings, never 0 boardings) and observed = 0. A recorded 0 has observed = 1 and its own scaled value.

boardings_scaler: mean and std of the fit-part training targets; applied to sequence values and the target
serving_change_policy: Stage 4b does not change the Stage 4a serving bundle. If a network wins on validation, it is reported and the user is asked before any serving change.
